lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: It's time for the meeting.
What meeting?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: What else, you dunce?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: The reporting of evil deeds for the Villain Union.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: If I don't submit a report of my evil deeds on a regular basis,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I might accidentally become righteous without even realizing it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That's why it's imperative that I hold these meetings.
Then allow me to commit an evil act and ignore this meeting.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hey, you shouldn't ignore people!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Now, listen to what I have to say.
Fine.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That's more like it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Okay, here's a breakdown of all my heinous acts this week:

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: There was a frail old lady asking where she could find a bank

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: because she urgently had to withdraw 3 million credits.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Apparently her son had called and said that his phone was broken,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: and had asked for some money to fix it.
So, did you rough up her son?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I just bought her a new phone.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That meant the old lady would never be able to find the bank!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Not only that, but I successfully deprived the phone shop of 3 million credits,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: which leaves them in the lurch!
... Well done, I suppose.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Besides, how come fixing your phone ends up being more expensive than just getting a new one?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: How much sense does that make?
None. It was clearly a scam.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Anyways,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I committed a whole bunch of other evil deeds,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: but none of them seemed to have much impact.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: The only thing people ever did was thank me!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I still have a ways to go before I become a true blue villain.
Keep at it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: And the same to you!
